bio_en: Vahan Manuelian was a quiet, modest young teacher in the Armenian schools of Bulgaria who had begun revolutionary work in Constantinople as a comrade of Babken Siuni. In autumn 1901 he crossed into the homeland to work in Taron and Sasun, becoming one of the most respected figures of the Sasun epic beside Hrayr and Andranik. He took part in the 1904 Sasun uprising and was killed in its fighting. His letters from Sasun were published in Droshak.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death in 1904 from context (Sasun 1904 battle stories link to him) - verify. A blog-only poem 'Spopank' signed Vahan Manuelian exists in the blog collection.
